title: Enterprise Support: Support campaign selection for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Support campaign selection for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: An approved negotiated support fraction takes no additional discount regardless of portfolio spending; otherwise, within the on-demand reconciliation branch without an applicable portfolio discount, apply eligible support promotion discount, or zero for an absent or expired promotion.

## Points of judgment

For retained-fee cash return: The approved negotiated support fraction takes no further discount even when portfolio spending is present. In the stated on-demand branch without an applicable portfolio discount, the non-negotiated price uses an eligible support campaign reduction; absent or expired campaigns give zero.
